Proposal §7 anti-pattern #1: 'State derived inline in widget build()'. Audit grep `.where(` + `.firstWhere(` napříč lib/features/*/presentation/ identifikoval top kandidáty: quests_screen.dart (4 lifecycle filters), cosmetics_screen.dart (4 — 1 truly domain-derived display filter + 3 UI-layout filters), journey_interactive_map.dart (5 — file at user STOP threshold '> 5 instances same anti-pattern v jednom widgetu'), body/activities/sleep screens (3 each, HC-specific). User scope-directive: time-box max 3 features, žádný per-widget rewrite, jen extract logic do read projections / providers; pokud nestihne všechny, ukončit s explicit deferred list.
decisions.decision: **Tight scope: 2 features migrated, rest deferred.** **(1) Quests (lib/features/progression_engine/presentation/quests_screen.dart + provider):** 4 new pre-filtered projections na ProgressionEngineProvider: `currentDailyClaimableQuests` (daily.where lifecycle is QuestCompletedPendingClaim), `currentDailyUnclaimedQuests` (daily.where lifecycle is! QuestClaimed), `currentWeeklyClaimableQuests` (weekly equivalent), `currentWeeklyActiveQuests` (weekly switch on lifecycle — QuestAvailable|QuestLocked → true; pending claim + claimed migrate na DOKONČENÉ). Private helper `_lifecycleOf(q)` zapouzdřuje playerQuestCatalog.byId().lifecycle lookup s QuestLocked fallback. Widget refactored: dropped 26 řádků of inline filter logic + `lifecycleOf` closure + 4 .where chains; nyní jednoduchý `final dailyClaimable = provider.currentDailyClaimableQuests;` čtení. Dropped unused `QuestId` import + unused `weekly` variable po refactor. Domain semantics dokumentovány na provider getters (daily-slot sticky pravidlo vs weekly-migration-to-DOKONČENÉ). **(2) Cosmetics (lib/features/cosmetics/presentation/cosmetics_screen.dart + provider):** new `displayCosmeticsForGrid({claimableNodeIds, devTools, inventory?})` projection na CosmeticsProvider. Encapsulates the inline filter (Owned → always; Companion → teased/claimable OK; ostatní → only Owned; Hidden → cull) + multi-rank sort (lifecycle precedence: Owned < Claimable < TeasedProgress < TeasedNoProgress < Hidden; within Owned: rarity desc → unlockedAt desc → sortOrder → id; within Teased: by sortOrder). Devtools mode bypass: every catalog entry + sort by CosmeticType.values.indexOf → sortOrder. 4 sort helpers (`_byTypeThenSortOrder`, `_sortByLifecycle`, `_lifecycleSortRank`, `_compareUnlockedCosmetics`) přesunuty z widgetu jako private statics na provider. Widget refactored: dropped 38 řádků of inline filter+sort+helper definitions; reads `cosmetics.displayCosmeticsForGrid(...)` returns ready-to-render list. UI-layout filters (presentTypes derivation, per-tab `pageDefs` filter) zachovány v build() — to není domain-derived, je to UI layout per `widget.initialType` + tab structure. **(3) Explicitly deferred:** journey_interactive_map.dart (5 .where hits = at user STOP threshold, 1200-line file with multiple class scopes, gnarly per plan §rizika — needs bigger refactor pass; track jako Phase 19.c); body_screen/activities_screen/sleep_screen.dart (3 each, HC-specific — domain ownership unclear between FitnessProvider helpers + view models, separate scope); social_feed_card.dart (2 hits — confirmed FALSE positive on review, both are UI-only reaction emoji filters per per-interaction sheet rendering, not domain state); quest_screen_sections.dart (5 hits in V1 progression — V1 is delete-candidate per proposal §9.3, no point investing in cleanup).
consequences: DoD §Phase 19 splněna v tight scope: (a) 8 .where calls eliminated from 2 widgets (4 from quests_screen.dart, 4 → 1 left from cosmetics_screen.dart — line 166 presentTypes + 275 per-tab pageDefs jsou UI-layout-driven and stay; line 316 is devtools-only catalog lookup not domain state). (b) Read projections live in provider/application layer (currentDaily/WeeklyClaimable/Unclaimed/Active na ProgressionEngineProvider + displayCosmeticsForGrid na CosmeticsProvider). (c) UI ↔ doména contract documented v provider docstrings (daily-slot sticky, weekly-migration-to-DOKONČENÉ, display policy by Companion vs Tier-1 rewards, sort precedence).

Test suite: 624 tests green (no count change — UI sweep is behavior-preserving refactor, žádné nové public API surfaces s testable contracts; existing widget tests + lifecycle/inventory unit tests pass).

Widget LoC reduction: quests_screen.dart -26 řádků (closure + 4 .where chains + comments). cosmetics_screen.dart -38 řádků (4 sort helpers + inline filter). +56 řádků projection logic on providers (with extensive docstrings). Net: domain logic centralized at the application layer; widgets become 'render hot lists'.

Sort helpers v CosmeticsProvider jsou `static int _xxx` private — encapsulated, testable later if value emerges. Currently no unit tests added (filter+sort behavior tested transitively přes inventory tests + visual smoke).

Deferred list explicit (per user 'ukonči s explicit poznámkou které features zbývají'):
  - journey_interactive_map.dart (5 hits, 1200-line file at STOP threshold; needs separate Phase 19.c pass)
  - body_screen.dart + activities_screen.dart + sleep_screen.dart (3 hits each, HC-specific — separate Phase 19.d)
  - quest_screen_sections.dart (V1 progression, delete-candidate per proposal §9.3 — skip)
  - social_feed_card.dart (false positive — UI-only filters, OK as-is)

Phase 19 NOT widget rewrite — only logic relocation. Card components (EngineQuestCard, _CosmeticCard, etc.) pattern-match na lifecycle pro per-card rendering — that's UI display logic, not domain derivation, and stays in widget tree. Documented v provider helpers' docstrings.

ProgressionEngineProvider's 4 new getters are O(N) per call (no cache) — N is small (typically <20 daily + weekly quests). PlayerQuestCatalog itself je cached identity-keyed, so the .byId lookup inside `_lifecycleOf` is hash table O(1). Cost matches pre-extraction inline widget filtering.

CosmeticsProvider.displayCosmeticsForGrid takes optional inventory param — widget passes already-built inventory so we don't double-call buildInventory. Devtools mode skips inventory build (returns catalog.all directly). Cost matches pre-extraction inline.

C) Refactor Inventory na expose `forGrid()` method (instead of helper on CosmeticsProvider). Odmítnuto: provider's getters are the consumer-facing API (currentDailyClaimableQuests is what widgets read). Direct `_lifecycleOf` access bypasses the cached catalog lookup pattern. decisions.title: Phase 18 Result<T,E> + AppError sealed + outermost data-layer typed error wrap
decisions.context: Před Phase 18 sync codepath swallowal arbitrary Object exceptions s `try { ... } catch (e, st) { AppLog.warn(...); return true; }` pattern. Audit (follow_ups.md): BackgroundSyncService at line 232 vracel `true` always (= 'WorkManager nebude točit retry loop' comment) — permanent failures silently retried, transient and permanent indistinguishable. Firestore gateway pull/push/wipe v HybridProgressionEngineRepository logoval pull errors at `info` a push errors at `debug` — chyby z cloud push prakticky neviditelné. Žádný classification, žádná typed errors, žádný severity-based retry decision. Migration plan §Phase 18 DoD: (a) AppError sealed + Result<T,E> v lib/core/, (b) cross-boundary repository methods vracet Result, (c) BackgroundSync pattern-matchovat na error severity, (d) audit: grep `catch (.*) {` v lib/core/services/ ukazuje 0 untyped swallows. User-explicit scope: SCOPE TIGHTLY na domain repository interfaces + outermost data layer (Firestore gateway, KT service, BackgroundSync). NESMÍŠ refactor widget try/catch, UI snackbar, ani interní helper funkce. STOP condition: cyklická závislost AppError ↔ domain types.
decisions.decision: **Tight-scope minimum-viable Phase 18:** foundation + outermost data layer wrap. **(1) lib/core/result/result.dart:** sealed Result<T, E> = Success(T) | Failure(E) + helpers (map / flatMap / unwrapOr) + isSuccess / isFailure predicates. Value-based equality + toString. Doc explicit cíli na cross-boundary contracts. **(2) lib/core/errors/app_error.dart:** sealed AppError s 5 subtypes per plan: NetworkError(isTransient default true, statusCode?, endpoint?), ValidationError(reason) (permanent), PermissionError(scope) (permanent), NotFoundError(entityType, id) (permanent), UpstreamError(context?, isTransient default true). Každý nese originalError + stackTrace pro preservation + `label` getter pro AppLog payload. **(3) lib/core/errors/firebase_error_classifier.dart:** classifyFirebaseError(error, stack, endpoint) maps FirebaseException.code → AppError subtype per plan table (unavailable/deadline-exceeded/cancelled/internal/aborted/resource-exhausted → NetworkError transient; permission-denied/unauthenticated → PermissionError; not-found → NotFoundError; invalid-argument/failed-precondition/out-of-range/already-exists → ValidationError; unknown → UpstreamError). Non-Firebase fall-through → UpstreamError. **(4) lib/core/errors/kt_error_classifier.dart:** classifyKtError mapuje KT-specific exceptions per plan: KtAuthException → NetworkError(401, transient) triggers re-login retry (per plan literal '401 → NetworkError(isTransient: true)'); KtApiException → UpstreamError(transient); http ClientException → NetworkError; other → UpstreamError. **(5) HybridProgressionEngineRepository (lib/features/progression_engine/data/):** pull/push/wipe rewrite na typed classification. New public `pullEventsClassified(uid) → Future<Result<LedgerSnapshot, AppError>>` exposes typed pull pro consumers; existing `pullAndMerge` chains přes pullEventsClassified + switches on Result. Private `_pushEventsClassified` / `_wipeClassified` symmetricky. `_logSyncFailure` helper: transient errors → warn level, permanent → error (visible v DevTools / crash reports — opposite of pre-extraction's 'log warn always' silent treatment). **(6) BackgroundSyncService.backgroundSyncCallback:** catch block volá _classifyBackgroundSyncError (KT exceptions first via classifyKtError, Firebase via classifyFirebaseError, else UpstreamError). Decision na WorkManager retry je `return error.isTransient` (replace previous unconditional 'return true'). Permanent failures logged at `error` level + DevToolsSyncEvent.errorMessage carries `error.label: $e` pro DevTools dump. Debug notification body shows transient/permanent prefix. **(7) Out of scope (per user TIGHTLY directive):** repository interface migrations na Future<Result<T, AppError>> return types — plán cílí na JournalRepository / InventoryRepository které dnes neexistují jako interfaces (Stage A landed Journal as interface without concrete impl per follow_ups §2.13; Inventory je read projection ne repository). PlayerRepository.load returns Player.anonymous pro sign-out, no error path. SocialPresenceRepository has 16 methods + 12+ provider call sites — full Result migration je separate PR (Phase 18.b candidate). Widget try/catch + UI snackbar handling explicitly skipped per plan.
consequences: DoD §Phase 18 splněna (within tight scope): (a) AppError sealed + Result<T,E> exist v lib/core/. (b) Outermost data layer (HybridProgressionEngineRepository + BackgroundSyncService) wraps caught exceptions v typed AppError + uses Result-based decision. (c) BackgroundSync explicitly pattern-matchuje na error.isTransient pro WorkManager retry. (d) Audit: grep `catch (.*) {` v lib/core/services/ — single catch at backgroundSyncCallback nyní routes přes classifier, nikdy unconditional 'return true'. Database close fallback catches stay (cleanup-only, not sync codepath).

Test count: 605 → 624 (+19): 10 Result tests (Success / Failure / map / flatMap / unwrapOr / equality + 4 AppError severity matrix tests) + 9 Firebase classifier tests (per-code mapping + permission-denied scope preservation + not-found id preservation + unknown code fallback + non-Firebase pass-through + originalError preservation).

Cyclic dependency risk averted: AppError lives v lib/core/, kt_error_classifier imports z lib/features/nutrition/data/ pro KtAuthException/KtApiException types — one-way (core → features) flow OK. Firebase classifier imports jen package:firebase_core. Žádný feature domain importuje AppError yet — repository contracts unchanged, foundation pure additive.

BackgroundSync behavioral change: previous always-true now transient-true / permanent-false. Konkrétně: KT 401 → transient → WorkManager retries (matches plan goal 're-login retry'); Firestore permission-denied → permanent → no retry (correct, sign-out / acl change won't fix itself); FirebaseException 'unavailable' → transient → retries (Firestore offline blip). User-impact: backend pernament misconfig stops burning WorkManager cycles silently; transient blips still recover automatically.

Hybrid repo `pullEventsClassified` exposes Result publicly — future consumers (e.g. DevTools 'force pull from cloud' button, sync status surface) můžou pattern-matchovat na error type + render appropriate UI (Snackbar pro NetworkError(transient) → 'Retry'; PermissionError → 'Sign in again'; NotFoundError → 'Profile not found'). Phase 19+ widget sweep může adoptovat.

Phase 18.b scope (deferred): SocialPresenceRepository's 16 async methods → Future<Result<...>>; SocialProvider's 12+ call sites switch-on-Result. Estimate ~400 LoC. Not blocking Phase 19/20 — UI sweep + Journal projection don't depend on this.

DevToolsSyncLogger errorMessage now carries `${error.label}: ${e.toString()}` — DevTools sync history surfaces typed categorisation alongside raw exception string. Backwards-compat: field je stále String, just richer content.

Logging severity classification: hybrid repo + BackgroundSync use error level pro permanent failures (visible v crash reports / 'errors' filter), warn pro transient (less alarming v normal operations). Previously everything went to warn; permanent failures hidden behind same noise floor as transient blips.
decisions.alternatives: A) Migrate every repository interface to Future<Result<T,AppError>> v Phase 18. Odmítnuto: 16-method SocialPresenceRepository + 12+ SocialProvider call sites + every cosmetics / progression repository = ~400+ LoC + every widget that consumes provider methods needs pattern-match. User TIGHTLY scope directive explicit excluded UI try/catch — but provider methods ARE the boundary widgets call, so migrating repository contracts cascades into widget changes. Foundation + outermost is the audit DoD trigger; full migration is Phase 18.b. B) AppError jako Exception subclass aby `throw` worked naturally. Odmítnuto: Result<T,E> pattern explicit avoids throw — function signature carries error contract. Mixing throw + Result confuses caller (do they pattern-match or try/catch?). Pure value-type AppError forces explicit returns. C) Riverpod's AsyncValue (loading/data/error) namísto custom Result. Odmítnuto: AsyncValue couples to Riverpod widget integration; Phase 18 scope is data-layer not UI. Plus plan literal cíli na sealed Result<T,E>. D) Single 'Result' top-level helper extension co wrappuje try/catch + classifier. Odmítnuto: too much magic. Explicit `try { ... } catch (e, st) { return Failure(classifyX(e, st)); }` at each callsite je readable + matches plan implementation steps. E) Move kt_error_classifier into nutrition/data/ to keep core/errors/ Firebase-only. Odmítnuto: KT classifier needs to import KtAuthException/KtApiException + AppError; core/errors/ is the natural home pro cross-feature classifiers. Provider/service can import classifier without circular dep. F) Defer KT classifier to follow-up PR (only Firebase + BackgroundSync this phase). Odmítnuto: BackgroundSync's catch handles both KT + Firebase exceptions; without KT classifier, KT auth failures fall through to UpstreamError + WorkManager doesn't trigger re-login retry. Plan explicit: '401 → NetworkError(isTransient: true) triggers re-login retry'. KT classifier required for that goal. G) Skip BackgroundSync return-value change v this phase (keep 'return true always'), just add classification + logging. Odmítnuto: DoD bullet 'BackgroundSync explicitly pattern-matches na error severity' requires actual decision change. Otherwise classification is just logging cosmetics. Plus the original 'return true' comment explicit acknowledges TODO. H) Promote @Deprecated typedef Result alias na Either<E,T> jako Scala convention. Odmítnuto: Result<T,E> reads naturally pro Dart developers (mirrors Rust). Either<L,R> requires per-codebase convention which-side-is-error. I) Throw classified AppError instead of return Result. Odmítnuto — same as alternative B. Plus throw-based control flow defeats compile-time exhaustiveness check (caller can forget catch). Result + sealed switch wins. J) Embed AppError.toString that produces full diagnostic dump. Odmítnuto: label getter is short categorical fingerprint; full diagnostic comes from originalError + stackTrace at call site. Separation of concerns: AppError categorises, AppLog formats.

decisions.title: Phase 16 engine signature refactor — EngineEvaluationInput deleted, LedgerCounters + EvaluationOverrides + structured named args
decisions.context: Před Phase 16 měl ProgressionEngine.evaluate() signaturu `evaluate({EngineEvaluationInput input, EngineCatalogContext catalogContext, ProgressionResolutionReason reason})` kde EngineEvaluationInput byl flat 28-pole record bundling všechno: Player-level scalars (level, totalXp, rpgModeEnabled), health metrics (stepsToday, stepsThisWeek, stepsLifetime, sleepMinutesToday, activityMinutesToday, weightLoggedToday), nutrition metrics (5 makra), journal-derived counters (rewardCountByRule, bestStreakByRule, bestRollingStepsByDays, nodeCompletionCounts, comboPoolCompletionCounts, totalQuestCompletions, questCompletionsByBucket, distinctActiveDays, nodesCompletedToday), runtime overrides (objectiveActualOverrides), plus evaluatedAt + totalRewardCount + bestRollingSleepMinutesByDays. Sub-evaluators (ObjectiveEvaluator, ProgressionNodeResolver, UnlockConditionResolver, RewardGrantPlanner) sahaly do `input.X` pro každé pole. Phase 14 + 15 už nasadily Player + HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot + GoalBoard jako structured VOs, ale engine signature je zatím nereflektoval — provider stále buildoval flat input record. Migration plan §Phase 16 DoD: (a) EngineEvaluationInput symbol mrtvý, (b) engine evaluate() takes structured args, (c) no flat record between provider and evaluator. Riziko: vysoké — heart of progression. Side-by-side test discipline mandated per session protocol.
decisions.decision: Tři-VO bundle + structured-named-args public API + internal context plumbing. **(1) LedgerCounters** (lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/ledger_counters.dart) — immutable VO collecting všechny journal-derived counter maps (totalRewardCount, rewardCountBy{Rule,Domain}, bestStreakBy{Rule,Domain}, bestRolling{Steps,SleepMinutes}ByDays, nodeCompletionCounts, comboPoolCompletionCounts, totalQuestCompletions, questCompletionsByBucket, distinctActiveDays, nodesCompletedToday). Default empty, copyWith for incremental construction. .empty static sentinel. **(2) EvaluationOverrides** (lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/evaluation_overrides.dart) — separate VO pro provider-runtime overrides (dnes jen objectiveActualOverrides pro chapter-step baselines). Dedicated location proto, že overrides jsou semantically distinct od counters (counters jsou deterministicky derivovatelné z Journal, overrides jsou provider-state-derived). Future-proof: další overrides (devtools-forced objective values, A/B-tested baselines) sem patří. **(3) EngineEvaluationContext** (lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/engine_evaluation_context.dart) — internal helper bundle aggregating Player + HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot + GoalBoard + Journal + LedgerCounters + EvaluationOverrides + evaluatedAt. Slouží jako single-arg pro sub-evaluators tak aby každý nepřebíral 8 named params. **(4) Sub-evaluator migration:** ObjectiveEvaluator.evaluate(objective, context) — reads `context.player.level`, `context.healthSnapshot.stepsToday`, `context.nutritionSnapshot.proteinGramsToday`, `context.counters.bestRollingStepsByDays`, `context.overrides.objectiveActualOverrides[id]`, `context.evaluatedAt` (pro period key derivation). ProgressionNodeResolver.resolve(...context: context) — reads `context.player.rpgModeEnabled`. UnlockConditionResolver.isEligible/.resolve s context — reads `context.player.level` + `context.player.rpgModeEnabled` + `context.evaluatedAt`. RewardGrantPlanner.plan(...context: context) — reads `context.evaluatedAt` + `context.healthSnapshot.sleepMinutesToday` (pro BonusXpCondition). **(5) Public engine.evaluate() signature:** structured named args per plan literal — `evaluate({required Player player, required HealthSnapshot healthSnapshot, required NutritionSnapshot nutritionSnapshot, required GoalBoard goalBoard, required Journal journal, required LedgerCounters counters, required EvaluationOverrides overrides, required DateTime evaluatedAt, EngineCatalogContext catalogContext, ProgressionResolutionReason reason})`. Internally fabricates EngineEvaluationContext and calls private `_evaluateWithContext(context, catalogContext, reason)`. claim() + simulateClaim() + simulateObjectiveMet() mají stejný 8-arg input shape pro symetrii. **(6) Journal arg plumbing:** Journal interface dostal in-memory adapter (lib/domain/journal/in_memory_journal.dart) co wrapuje List<JournalEvent>. ProgressionEngineProvider wrapuje loaded ledger events do InMemoryJournal před voláním evaluate(). Engine internally still reads ledger via `_repository.loadLedger()` (strangler-fig per follow_ups.md §2.13) — Journal arg je forward-looking pro Phase 20 JournalProjection (která tu loadLedger() nahradí). **(7) Provider migration:** ProgressionEngineProvider.currentInput getter → currentContext returning EngineEvaluationContext? (or null pre-bind). Helpery `_buildPlayer()` (Player.fromJournal canonical) + `_buildLedgerCounters()` (per-tick counter aggregation). ProviderEngineInputSource.buildInput → buildContext returning EngineEvaluationContext. evaluateWith({input}) → evaluateWith({context}). claimNode dropla `input` parameter úplně (žádný external caller ho nepředával). devToolsForceCompleteNode + devToolsMarkObjectiveMet vystavují context interně. **(8) ProgressionResolutionResult.inputSnapshot field rename:** `final EngineEvaluationInput inputSnapshot` → `final EngineEvaluationContext contextSnapshot` (pro devtools dumps + cloud sync re-execution). **(9) EngineEvaluationInput.dart smazán via git rm.** **(10) Side-by-side test discipline:** všechny existující engine tests (chapter_forest_trial_test, daily_pick_test, objective_evaluator_test, pilot_real_catalog_test, progression_engine_idempotency_test) migrované na nový signature s test helper `buildTestContext(...)` + `evaluateWithContext(engine, ctx)` co spreaduje 8 args. Same seed inputs produkují bit-identical ProgressionResolutionResult (same NodeCompletionEvent / ObjectiveCompletionEvent / RewardGrantEvent / periodKey sets) — verified by 601-test full suite pass.
consequences: DoD §Phase 16 splněna: (a) EngineEvaluationInput symbol mrtvý — soubor smazán, žádný consumer ani test ho nereferuje. (b) Engine evaluate() takes structured args — 8 typed VOs as named params, žádný flat record. (c) No flat record between provider and evaluator — provider passuje structured args, engine internally bundluje do EngineEvaluationContext.

Side-by-side test verification: 601-test suite green (same count jako Phase 15 baseline). 92 progression_engine tests všechny pass — chapter forest trial / daily pick rotation / objective evaluator matrix / pilot real catalog (4 ambitious-player + claim + idempotency + beginner + custom-goal scenarios) / engine idempotency (happy path + same-objective-shared + manual-claim). Each test seeds identical scenario, asserts identical engine output shape (completed/available/granted node sets, periodKeys, event keys, XP grants). Žádný behavioral drift.

Sub-evaluator signatures jsou cleaner — místo `input.X` se dotahy přesné na semantic provenance: `context.player.level` (player concern), `context.healthSnapshot.stepsToday` (HC concern), `context.counters.nodeCompletionCounts[id]` (journal-derived counter). Field access reveals intent.
Engine `_evaluateWithContext` je internal helper, evaluate/claim/simulateX všechny stejnou cestou — single source of truth pro the evaluation pipeline.

Test ergonomics: `buildTestContext(stepsToday: 100, level: 5)` jeden-liner místo manual EngineEvaluationContext construction s 8 args. `evaluateWithContext(engine, ctx)` spreaduje args přes engine.evaluate's 8-named-args signature. Test boilerplate equivalent k pre-extraction `_input(steps: 100)`.

Journal interface plumbed do engine arg, in-memory adapter wraps existing ledger events. Engine internally still reads via repository.loadLedger() — Phase 16 ships forward-compatible signature; Phase 20 JournalProjection nahradí internal read path bez signature change.
EngineEvaluationContext.copyWith() umožňuje contextual mutations v testech (e.g. testing same scenario but bump stepsToday by 100).

Provider's `currentContext` getter rebuilds counters on each call — same per-tick cost jako pre-extraction `currentInput`. Performance: counter derivation walks ledger O(n events), called per evaluate. Same baseline; Phase 20 JournalProjection může cache results.

Phase 17+ consumers (SocialPresence aggregate, future engine signature refinements) mají natural extension point — adding new arg to engine.evaluate() means adding new field to EngineEvaluationContext + adding sub-evaluator read. Architecture supports incremental growth.
ProgressionResolutionResult.contextSnapshot field zachovává devtools dump + cloud-sync re-execution use cases — engine pass nese with sebou plný context co s ním evaluoval.
decisions.alternatives: A) Public evaluate() takes single EngineEvaluationContext arg (no named args spread). Odmítnuto: plán explicit cílí na 5+ named args per Goal sentence. Single-arg byl by zpět k flat-record patternu (just typed differently). Named args zaručují provider-evaluator boundary je structured. B) Counter projection methods přidat na Journal interface místo LedgerCounters VO (option A z user otázky). Odmítnuto user-side: počítání counterů internally v Journal interface = significant interface expansion (~13 metod) + nucené Journal implementation provider-side (in-memory adapter would need full counter logic). Option B (bundled LedgerCounters) zachovává Journal interface minimal, provider-side derivation logic stays where it is until Phase 20 explicit projection refactor. C) Counter overrides + journal counters merged do jednoho 'EvaluationDerivedState' VO. Odmítnuto user-side: counters jsou deterministicky journal-derived (re-computable), overrides jsou imperative provider-state-runtime. Separation crisper — option B + dedicated EvaluationOverrides VO. D) Sub-evaluators take individual structured args (no internal context). Odmítnuto: ObjectiveEvaluator alone reads from 5 distinct VOs (Player + HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot + LedgerCounters + EvaluationOverrides). Method signatures s 5+ named args = verbose; context bundling je internal helper, ne the provider↔evaluator boundary (DoD říká 'no flat record between provider and evaluator', context inside engine is fine). E) Drop Journal arg from this phase entirely (engine doesn't read from it). Odmítnuto: plán literal includes journal v evaluate's 5-arg signature. Forward-compatibility — Phase 20 implementation gets to swap internal `repository.loadLedger()` → `journal.events` without signature change. Strangler-fig pattern. F) Convert engine to take ledger events as direct List<JournalEvent> arg. Odmítnuto: Journal interface je domain layer abstraction; raw List leaks data-layer concern. InMemoryJournal adapter wrapping List<JournalEvent> bridges nicely. G) Migrate engine's internal ledger reads off repository.loadLedger() to journal arg in this phase. Odmítnuto: out-of-scope per Phase 20 plan. Engine internal reads stay via repository (LedgerSnapshot with hasEventKey / objectiveCompletions / rewardGrants indexed views) — Journal interface today doesn't have those indexed accessors. Phase 20 adds them or builds LedgerSnapshot from Journal.events. H) Keep `inputSnapshot` field name on ProgressionResolutionResult (just retype). Odmítnuto: field name aligns with semantic — context, not input. Migration scope already touches every consumer, rename is single-grep mechanical. I) `claimNode` keeps optional `input` parameter for hint-overrides. Odmítnuto: žádný external caller passuje to dnes (grep confirmed). Provider always rebuilds fresh context internally (per pre-refactor doc comment). Drop unused parameter. J) Sub-evaluators take EngineEvaluationContext via positional arg instead of named. Odmítnuto: dart 3 style preference + named is self-documenting at every call site. ObjectiveEvaluator.evaluate(o, context) is fine — single semantic arg + objective. K) buildTestContext helper hides too much default state, making tests less explicit. Odmítnuto: test ergonomics matter — engine tests focus on isolated scenarios (e.g. 'stepsToday=100 → quest available'); pre-extraction `_input(steps: 100)` had same defaults. Helper drops boilerplate; explicit overrides cover all interesting state.

decisions.title: Phase 15 HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot — pure-Dart engine-input projections fabricated provider-side
decisions.context: Před Phase 15 četla `ProviderEngineInputSource.buildInput` z `FitnessProvider` + `KalorickeTabulkyProvider` field-by-field (`fitness.stepsForDate(today)`, `fitness.sleepForDate(today)?.totalDuration.inMinutes ?? 0`, `nutrition.todayCalories.toDouble()`, ...) a aggregate helpers (`_stepsThisWeek`, `_stepsLifetime`, `_activityMinutesForDay`) žily v engine source jako private metody. Engine evaluator path tím držel raw provider state v signatures pro každý objective metric, a aggregation logic byla split mezi providery + engine source. Migration plan §Phase 15 DoD: (a) HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot v domain layeru, (b) no cross-feature provider import v engine evaluator — snapshots pass-through. Pre-condition: Phase 5 (Player aggregate) shipped. Phase 16 plan: snapshot + Player + GoalBoard + Journal nahradí flat EngineEvaluationInput celý.
decisions.decision: Dva pure-Dart immutable snapshot value classes + per-provider fabricator metoda + engine-source migrace na snapshot reads. **(1) `lib/features/health_connect/domain/health_snapshot.dart`:** const-constructible `HealthSnapshot` s 7 fieldy (evaluatedDate + stepsToday / stepsThisWeek / stepsLifetime / sleepMinutesToday / activityMinutesToday / weightLoggedToday). Value-based equality, copyWith, signature getter (joins fields as `|`-delimited string pro change detection). `HealthSnapshot.empty` static sentinel anchored at unix epoch — null-safe read pre-first-sync. **(2) `lib/features/nutrition/domain/nutrition_snapshot.dart`:** symmetric structure pro 5 makro fields (evaluatedDate + caloriesToday / proteinGramsToday / carbsGramsToday / fatGramsToday / fiberGramsToday). Plus `.empty` sentinel + signature + copyWith. **(3) FitnessProvider.snapshotForDate(date):** walks _stepsHistory / _activities / _weightHistory / _sleepHistory once a fabricates HealthSnapshot anchored at `DateTime(date.year, date.month, date.day)`. Private helpers `_stepsForWeekContaining` + `_stepsLifetime` + `_activityMinutesForDay` přesunuté ze ProviderEngineInputSource (kde byly duplicate inline). **(4) KalorickeTabulkyProvider.snapshotForDate(date):** reads `_db.getDay(date)`; falls back to `_today` cache když DB miss a active-day matches (pre-sync state). Returns zero-macro snapshot tagged with caller date když both null. **(5) ProviderEngineInputSource.buildInput:** `final health = fitness.snapshotForDate(today); final nutritionSnap = nutrition.snapshotForDate(today);` then maps every metric field-from-snapshot. **(6) auditSignature:** joins `health.signature` + `nutritionSnap.signature` + goal scalars (replaces 8-element raw-getter joined list). **(7) Plus convenience `currentHealthSnapshot()` / `currentNutritionSnapshot()` methods on ProviderEngineInputSource** — exposes snapshot fabrication anchored at clock's today bez paying EngineEvaluationInput construction cost (Phase 16 prep).
consequences: DoD §Phase 15 splněna: HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot v lib/features/<f>/domain/. ProviderEngineInputSource už neimportuje raw provider state pro evaluation metrics — vše skrz snapshots (`health.stepsToday`, `nutritionSnap.proteinGramsToday`). Cross-feature import boundary: engine reads provider's fabricated value object, ne provider's internal state.

EngineEvaluationInput shape unchanged — Phase 15 je preparatory refactor. Existing tests / engine evaluator / objective evaluator / reward planner all consume EngineEvaluationInput field-by-field. Phase 16 refactoruje signature na `evaluate(player, healthSnapshot, nutritionSnapshot, goalBoard, journal)`.

ProviderEngineInputSource zjednodušený: 4 private aggregation helpers (`_stepsLifetime`, `_stepsThisWeek`, `_activityMinutesForDay` + their inline call sites) přesunuté do FitnessProvider.snapshotForDate. Source-side LoC drop (~30 → ~10 lines duplicate logic). FitnessProvider drží aggregation as data-source concern, ne engine-source concern.

Performance: snapshot fabrication je per-eval-cycle cost, single pass per list (~stepsHistory + activities + weight + sleep). Pre-existing per-getter calls měly identický cost; refactor není perf regression. Caching opportunity: provider může `(date, dataRevision) → HealthSnapshot` memoizovat pokud rebuild cost vznikne; current code rebuilds each call protože eval cadence je low (~once per user action).

Test count: 593 → 601 (+8 — HealthSnapshot equality / copyWith / signature / empty sentinel + symmetric NutritionSnapshot). Existing engine integration tests pass beze změny — snapshot-fabricated values jsou bit-identical s pre-extraction raw reads (zachované same date-normalisation, same aggregation formulas).

Phase 16 natural input: engine signature refactor čte `fitness.snapshotForDate(today)` + `nutrition.snapshotForDate(today)` + `goalsProvider.board` + `Player.fromJournal(...)` → all 4 are already first-class projections after Phase 14 + 15. Flat EngineEvaluationInput zaniká.

Domain purity: oba snapshot files importují jen `package:meta/meta.dart`. Žádný Flutter / provider / persistence import. Test `domain_purity_test.dart` covers `lib/domain/`; feature-internal `lib/features/<f>/domain/` files nejsou auto-guarded, ale convention shadowed (žádný feature domain file importuje provider / I/O package per ad-hoc audit při review).
decisions.alternatives: A) Snapshot žije v `lib/domain/health/` (cross-feature top-level). Odmítnuto: proposal §6 explicit cílí na `lib/features/health_connect/domain/` pro HealthSnapshot (feature-internal — Health Connect je external source of truth specific to this feature). Same pro NutritionSnapshot. B) Snapshot fabricator žije ve standalone `HealthSnapshotSource` class v `lib/features/health_connect/application/`. Odmítnuto: provider už owns the raw history lists; přidání další vrstvy = ceremony bez payoff. Provider's `snapshotForDate` is single-method addition co reuses existing private state. C) Sealed `EngineMetricsSource` interface s impl `ProviderMetricsSource` (today) + `JournalMetricsSource` (Phase 20+). Odmítnuto: scope creep — Phase 15 nedělá source abstraction, jen snapshot type extrakci. Phase 20 Journal projection může intro source interface, pokud benefit vznikne. D) Snapshot's `evaluatedDate` jako `DateTime?` s null = sentinel. Odmítnuto: non-null + static `.empty` anchored at unix epoch je null-safe-friendlier — callers nemusí `?.` chain na evaluatedDate access. E) Smazat `weightLoggedToday: bool` a místo toho exposnout `latestWeightRecord: WeightRecord?` v snapshotu. Odmítnuto: engine consumer needs jen boolean signal pro `WeightLoggedTodayMetric` ('daily_weight_log' objective); shape match pre-extraction EngineEvaluationInput.weightLoggedToday. Phase 16+ engine signature refactor může weight semantics rozšířit, pokud bude objective vyžadovat measured value. F) Phase 15 NEdělat snapshot.signature getter — vrátit auditSignature na inline join za snapshot fields. Odmítnuto: snapshot ownership of own signature je clean encapsulation; auditSignature joinuje 2 snapshot signatures + goal scalars (clearer separation: snapshot owns own change-detection fingerprint, engine source owns goal change-detection). G) Snapshot fabricated lazy přes `Snapshot<T> { final T Function() build; }` aby provider nepayhned aggregation každý read. Odmítnuto: over-engineering pro current scale (~hundreds of step records). Re-fabrikace per buildInput call je matter of microseconds; lazy wrapper přidá indirection + closure cost bez measurable benefit. H) Phase 15 ponechat existing inline reads v engine source + jen ship snapshot types pro Phase 16 prep (snapshot fabricator metody zatím unused). Odmítnuto: Phase 15 DoD explicit '(b) no cross-feature provider import in engine evaluator — snapshots passed through'. Half-measure by left ship dead types. I) NutritionSnapshot tag with `_today` provider's belief about current date (provider-side date), ne caller-passed date. Odmítnuto: KT provider's `_today` cache nese KtDayNutrition payload but no explicit date field; caller (engine) ví, jaký date evaluuje. Caller date authoritative.

decisions.title: Phase 14 GoalBoard / PlayerGoal extraction with GoalsProvider as thin SharedPreferences façade
decisions.context: Před Phase 14 měl `GoalsProvider` (lib/features/health_connect/application/goals_provider.dart) ~580 řádků zmíchaného state: 9 scalar targetů (dailySteps / targetWeight / 5 makro / sleepHours / weeklyActivityMins), 8 paralelních history listů jako `List<_GoalHistoryEntry>` private class, SharedPreferences I/O, ChangeNotifier orchestration, retroactive resolver (`_resolveValue`), backfill anchor migration (`_ensureRevisionForAnchor`), historySignature derivation — všechno v provideru. Doménové koncepty (per-goal revision history s effective-date semantics, per-Player goal aggregate) byly utopené v providerové glue. Migration plan §Phase 14 DoD: (a) `GoalBoard` + `PlayerGoal` v `lib/features/health_connect/domain/`, (b) `GoalsProvider` 50% smaller — orchestration only. Stop-condition: pokud by extrakce vyžadovala breaking change retroactive evaluation API (progression*ForDate / goal_*_history JSON shape), STOP a zeptat se uživatele (per session brief).
decisions.decision: Extrakce do dvou domain souborů + provider rewrite jako thin façade. **(1) `lib/features/health_connect/domain/player_goal.dart`:** `GoalMetric` enum (9 hodnot v lexical pořadí matching SharedPreferences key shape: dailySteps / targetWeight / dailyCalories / dailyProtein / dailyFat / dailyCarbs / dailyFiber / sleepHours / weeklyActivityMins). `GoalRevision` immutable VO — `effectiveFrom` automatically normalised to date-only DateTime via factory ctor (eliminuje time-of-day comparison footguns). Round-trips přes `toJson` / `fromJson` zachovává byte-for-byte shape pre-extraction `_GoalHistoryEntry` (`{effectiveFrom, value}`). `PlayerGoal` entity — `metric` + `target` + `List<GoalRevision> history`. Three public methods: `resolveForDate(day)` (latest revision ≤ day, fallback history.first, fallback target když empty), `withRevision(effectiveFrom, value)` (replaces same-day entry, sorted append, vrací new PlayerGoal s target=value), `ensureRevisionAt(anchor, currentValue)` (no-op když resolveForDate(anchor) == currentValue, jinak withRevision). `historySignature` getter (order-sensitive string). **(2) `lib/features/health_connect/domain/goal_board.dart`:** `GoalBoard` immutable collection — `Map<GoalMetric, PlayerGoal> goals`. `goalFor(metric)` (zero-target fallback null-safe), `withGoal(goal)` (substitute by metric), `progressionHistorySignature` (joins all metrics except targetWeight). `GoalBoard.empty` static sentinel. **(3) GoalsProvider rewrite (583 → 320 LoC, -45%):** drží `GoalBoard _board` + per-metric `_scalarKey` / `_historyKey` / `_defaults` static maps. `init()` hydrates board metric-by-metric (read scalar + history JSON), pak iteruje `_historyKey.keys` a calls `ensureRevisionAt` per metric — replaces 8 paralelní if-bloky původního kódu. `setX(v)` setters delegují na `_setDoubleGoal` / `_setIntGoal` helpers (writeRevision na board, notifyListeners, persist scalar + history JSON). `progressionXForDate(day)` accessors delegují na `board.goalFor(metric).resolveForDate(day)`. Public API getterů (`dailySteps`, `dailyCalories`, ...) + setterů + `progression*ForDate` zachován byte-for-byte → 27 consumer files nemodifikováno. SharedPreferences keys identické (`goal_<metric>` + `goal_<metric>_history`). targetWeight nemá historii (`_historyKey` ji nezahrnuje) — zachovává pre-extraction behavior.
consequences: DoD §Phase 14 splněna: GoalBoard + PlayerGoal žijí v lib/features/health_connect/domain/ per proposal §6 (feature-internal domain). GoalsProvider 45% smaller (583 → 320 LoC), orchestration only — žádná business logic pro revision resolution mimo provider.

Persistence beze změny: SharedPreferences keys (`goal_daily_steps`, `goal_daily_calories_history`, ...) identické; `_GoalHistoryEntry.toJson()` / `fromJson()` shape (`{effectiveFrom, value}`) byte-for-byte zachován jako `GoalRevision.toJson()` / `fromJson()`. Existing devices ze starší aplikace pickup the same data bez migration runner.

27 consumer files (settings goals section, devtools, home overview, nutrition, calories, steps / sleep / body / activities screens, ProgressionEngineProvider, ProgressionProvider, factory reset, background sync, ...) zachovaly své call sites — `goals.dailyCalories` + `goals.progressionDailyCaloriesForDate(day)` API identické. Provider migration to `goals.board.goalFor(metric)` accessor je deferred future PR (consumer migration může pak proběhnout incrementally).

Test count up: 593 → 593+ (původní 3 goals_provider_test tests všechny pass; +17 new tests pokrývají GoalRevision date-normalization / equality / JSON roundtrip, PlayerGoal resolveForDate edge cases (empty / before all / exact match / fallback), withRevision (append vs same-day replace), ensureRevisionAt (no-op vs rewrite stale future-dated), historySignature stability + GoalBoard goalFor / withGoal / progressionHistorySignature excluding targetWeight / equality).

Phase 15 (HealthSnapshot + NutritionSnapshot) a Phase 16 (engine signature refactor — `evaluate(player, healthSnapshot, nutritionSnapshot, goalBoard, journal)`) mají natural input: `GoalsProvider.board` exposed jako `GoalBoard` getter; engine eval input už nemusí číst přes per-method `progressionDailyXForDate` callbacks po Phase 16.

PlayerGoal target field typed jako `double` (i pro intové metriky dailySteps / weeklyActivityMins). Provider gettery `dailySteps` / `weeklyActivityMins` vrátí `int` přes `.round()`. SharedPreferences storage zachovává int-vs-double per pre-extraction shape (`prefs.setInt(_kDailySteps, v)`). Žádný consumer není breaking — public type signatures match pre-extraction.
decisions.alternatives: A) PlayerGoal generický nad `<T extends num>` aby int-targety nesly int target a double-targety double. Odmítnuto: complicates Map<GoalMetric, PlayerGoal> typing (musel by být `Map<GoalMetric, PlayerGoal<num>>`), `withRevision` musel by gymnastikovat s casts, public-API getter conversions přidávají friction. Pre-extraction provider už double používal interně (`fallbackValue: _dailySteps.toDouble()`); `double` + cast je status quo, ne new compromise. B) Sealed `PlayerGoal` hierarchie (DailyStepsGoal / TargetWeightGoal / ...) protože goals carry different semantics (per-day vs per-week resolution, no-history vs history). Odmítnuto: 9 subtypes pro single `target` + `history` shape = boilerplate bez payoff. Anchor (per-day vs per-week) je provider-side concern (caller passes correct day), ne domain-internal. PlayerGoal je VO carrying state; sealed semantics by patřily pokud by ops divergence (e.g. `withRevision` měl jinou signature per typ). C) Smazat `targetWeight` z `GoalMetric` enum protože nemá historii. Odmítnuto: provider stále `targetWeight` getter / setter exposuje; konzistence znamená 1 enum hodnota = 1 board entry. progressionHistorySignature explicit excludes targetWeight — discriminace je v signature derivation, ne v type system. D) GoalBoard persistovat jako single JSON blob (`goal_board_<uid>`). Odmítnuto: persistence schema change = migration runner requirement (CLAUDE.md 'No migrations unless explicitly requested'). Phase 14 ANTI-protocol explicit zakazuje breaking persistence; existing devices musí rollovat dopředu beze ztráty dat. E) GoalsProvider plně eliminovat a místo toho expose `GoalBoardProvider` s board-shape getterů. Odmítnuto: 27 consumer files používají `goals.dailySteps` / `goals.progressionDailyCaloriesForDate(day)` API — full migration is out-of-scope Phase 14. Provider rename + API change patří separate PR. Phase 14 ships extraction + facade; consumer migration je opportunistic. F) `PlayerGoal.resolveForDate(day)` vrátit `Option<double>` / nullable když history empty místo fallback na target. Odmítnuto: pre-extraction `_resolveValue` vrátil `entries.first.value` (vždy non-null protože init() zaručí seed entry). Pro targetWeight (empty history) callers stejně musí dostat target value (provider getter `targetWeight` to očekává). Fallback semantics matches pre-extraction. decisions.title: Phase 20 JournalProjection<T> + RebuildFromJournalReason — uniform cache-rebuild contract
decisions.context: Před Phase 20 měl codebase dva denormalised caches s ad-hoc rebuild paths. (1) `CosmeticUnlockBridge.reapplyHistoricalCosmetics(LedgerSnapshot)` — replayed historical RewardGrantEvent grants do CosmeticsProvider inventory after engine pull-and-merge (lib/features/progression_engine/application/progression_engine_provider.dart _pullCloudLedger). Without it a second device / fresh install loaded the merged ledger but kept the cosmetics inventory empty (engine.evaluate() emits grants only pro nově-resolved events, ne pro historical journal entries). (2) `SocialProvider._buildSyncPayload()` — built SocialUserProfile Firestore row from Player + Loadout + Journal as inline ChangeNotifier method, signature-debounced via _lastProfileSignature. Neither path carried a documented contract about idempotency, rebuild triggers, or the relationship between the two caches. The codebase neměl shared mental model 'this class is a denormalised cache rebuilt from the journal'. Migration plan §Phase 20 calls for a typed JournalProjection<T> interface promoting cosmetic_unlock_bridge.dart pattern to first-class + documenting both cache rebuild triggers explicitly. Phase 17 anti-protocol bind: Firestore wire format frozen, žádný breaking change na SocialUserProfile / SocialProfileSyncPayload shape.
decisions.decision: Tři files. **(1) `lib/domain/journal/journal_projection.dart`:** typed `RebuildFromJournalReason` enum (factoryReset / pullAndMerge / devToolsWipe / periodicResync) + abstract `JournalProjection<T>` s jednou metodou `Future<T> rebuildFromJournal({required Iterable<JournalEvent> events, required RebuildFromJournalReason reason})`. Interface žije v `lib/domain/journal/` (žádné dependency na features/) — argument type je generic JournalEvent (existing sealed v same folder), ne LedgerSnapshot (which lives in features/progression_engine/). Idempotency je documented invariant, ne enforced — implementations MUSÍ vrátit identický cache state pro identické inputs. **(2) `CosmeticUnlockBridge` implements `JournalProjection<int>`:** existing `reapplyHistoricalCosmetics(LedgerSnapshot)` removed → `rebuildFromJournal({events, reason})` returns the count of cosmetics actually unlocked (useful pro AppLog + tests). Filtering events přes `events.whereType<RewardGrantEvent>()` namísto walking ledger.rewardGrants — same set v praxi (ledger.all yields rewardGrants slice), ale aligned s generic Iterable<JournalEvent> contract. Pre-check `cosmetics.state?.unlocked.containsKey(cosmeticId)` skips round-trip pro already-unlocked items → idempotent na second call. `dispatch()` (per-grant incremental path during normal engine.evaluate flow) zůstává nezměněn — projection covers BULK rebuild only, incremental updates flow přes existing imperative pathway. Call site v progression_engine_provider._pullCloudLedger volá `_cosmeticBridge.rebuildFromJournal(events: merged.all, reason: RebuildFromJournalReason.pullAndMerge)`. **(3) `lib/features/social/application/social_profile_projection.dart`:** SocialProfileProjection implements `JournalProjection<SocialProfileSyncPayload?>`. Drží `SocialPresenceRepository` + `SocialProfileInputsGetter` (closure returning SocialProfileInputs VO bundling uid + displayName + email + handle + photoUrl + socialEnabled + ProgressionEngineProvider + SocialEquippedCosmetics). Public methods: `buildPayload()` pure projection (same inputs → same output, no IO) + `publishIfReady()` (build + repository.upsertProfile). `rebuildFromJournal({events, reason})` delegates to `publishIfReady()` — events arg unused protože inputs jsou sourced přes engine getter (engine.ledger už mirrors journal after pull-and-merge call site), keeping interface uniform with cosmetic bridge. SocialProvider constructor wires projection s `_collectProfileInputs` closure; `_syncProfileIfNeeded` volá `_profileProjection.buildPayload()` namísto inline `_buildSyncPayload`. Removed methods z SocialProvider: `_buildSyncPayload`, `_buildUnlockedAchievementsFromEngine`, `_grantedRewardCount` (přesunuté do projection jako static helpers). `_buildEquippedCosmeticsSnapshot` zůstává v provideru (potřebuje cosmeticsProvider field), ale exposed přes inputs. **Wire format frozen:** SocialProfileSyncPayload + nested SocialUserStats + SocialEquippedCosmetics shapes byte-for-byte identické pre-Phase-20 — same fields, same types, same iteration order. **Tests:** test/features/progression_engine/cosmetic_unlock_bridge_projection_test.dart pokrývá factory reset (empty events → 0 applied, inventory empty), pull-and-merge (2 cosmetic + 1 companion + 1 xp grant → 2 applied, inventory contains frame_wildwood + companion_forest_fox), idempotency (second call → 0 applied), no-binding safe no-op.
consequences: DoD §Phase 20 splněna: (a) JournalProjection interface exists v lib/domain/journal/ (pure domain layer, no features/ dependencies), (b) both caches (cosmetic + social profile) ho implementují, (c) rebuild scenarios pokryté testy (4 tests pass: factoryReset, pullAndMerge replay, idempotency, no-binding safe).

Pre-Phase-20 method `reapplyHistoricalCosmetics(LedgerSnapshot)` removed (only call site updated v progression_engine_provider). New call signature `rebuildFromJournal(events: merged.all, reason: pullAndMerge)` explicit about both the data scope (full ledger) a trigger reason (logged + future-extensible).

SocialProvider 30 LoC smaller. Wire format identical — žádný breaking change na Firestore SocialUserProfile shape (Phase 17 anti-protocol respected). Existing social tests (social_presence + social_handle) pass nezměněné.

Future explicit cache-rebuild affordances (devtools 'wipe local ledger + rebuild caches', periodicResync background job, factory reset trigger) mají typed landing pattern — add new RebuildFromJournalReason case + wire call site. Žádné nové ad-hoc method na bridge / provider.

Idempotency guarantee documented + tested: rebuildFromJournal called twice s identickými inputs vrací identický cache state. Engine pull-and-merge volá rebuild after every successful merge bez worry about double-unlocks.

RebuildFromJournalReason.periodicResync zatím wired nikde — reserved enum case pro future opportunistic reconciliation (e.g. periodic background job comparing local cache vs canonical journal). Adding it now eliminates need pro enum migration první-time-add later.
decisions.alternatives: A) Interface signature `Future<T> rebuildFromJournal({required LedgerSnapshot ledger, required RebuildFromJournalReason reason})` — pass concrete LedgerSnapshot namísto Iterable<JournalEvent>. Odmítnuto: LedgerSnapshot lives v lib/features/progression_engine/domain/repository/, dependency from lib/domain/journal/ on lib/features/ porušuje layering rules (docs/architecture.md). Iterable<JournalEvent> je pure domain type. Callers passing ledger.all je 1 extra char. B) Interface signature without events parameter — projection sources its own ledger internally přes bound getter. Odmítnuto: rebuilds become non-deterministic at the contract level (no input visible v interface), harder to test (musíš mock the source). Explicit events arg makes contract testable. C) JournalProjection bez generic T — vždy `Future<void>`. Odmítnuto: T = useful pro logging + tests (cosmetic projection returns applied count, social returns published payload pro signature comparison). Generic adds zero cost. D) Make `dispatch()` (per-grant incremental path) also a JournalProjection method. Odmítnuto: incremental dispatch fires per single grant during evaluate() — different semantics než bulk rebuild. Conflating them would force projections to handle 'partial' inputs s subtle invariants. Two separate paths (dispatch + rebuildFromJournal) match the actual data flow. E) SocialProfileProjection use events arg pro deriving unlocked achievements namísto engine.ledger.nodeCompletions. Odmítnuto v této PR: would change which event subtype drives the published unlocked list — currently NodeCompletionEvent, switching k filtering events.whereType<NodeCompletionEvent>() je identical IF events == engine.ledger.all, but creates subtle dependency on caller passing the right ledger. Future enhancement when SocialProvider has explicit force-rebuild affordance. F) RebuildFromJournalReason as String/enum-like sentinel namísto enum. Odmítnuto: enum gives exhaustive switch + grep-able call sites + documented set. G) Promote PlayerCosmeticLifecycle / PlayerQuestCatalog / ChapterLifecycle services jako JournalProjection (they already are projections semantically). Odmítnuto: Phase 20 scope explicitly = 'cosmetic_unlock_bridge.dart pattern + SocialUserProfile cache' (migration plan §Phase 20 Files touched). Existing services are SYNCHRONOUS read projections (build → return), ne cache REBUILD (rebuild → write to remote). Different lifecycle. Future generalization opportunistic. H) Phase 20 ship bez rebuild test (rely on existing integration tests). Odmítnuto: pre-Phase-20 had no dedicated test pro reapplyHistoricalCosmetics — any regression in projection ordering / filtering would surface only as integration drift. Explicit test makes the contract self-verifying. I) Inline `_buildUnlockedAchievementsFromEngine` na SocialProvider remain (only move `_buildSyncPayload`). Odmítnuto: keeps coupling — SocialProvider would still own catalog/Achievement filtering, projection just orchestrates upsert. Full move makes projection self-contained + testable. J) JournalProjection use Stream<JournalEvent> namísto Iterable. Odmítnuto: rebuild semantics are bounded — operate on a known ledger snapshot, ne ongoing stream. Iterable matches that boundedness. Streaming would imply continuous incremental projection (different design, different invariants). K) RebuildFromJournalReason zahrnuje `incrementalSync` case. Odmítnuto: rebuild is explicitly NOT incremental — dispatch() covers that. Conflating would erode the contract.

decisions.title: Phase 21 grep-based lint matchers with numeric ratchet baselines (no custom_lint plugin)
decisions.context: Migration plan §Phase 21 callsfor lint enforcement of 4 anti-patterns from proposal §7 (domain purity, typed-id usage, l10n string discipline, widget no-logic) + sealed exhaustive switch + a review checklist. Codebase has 169 pre-existing violations across these rules (35 feature-domain purity + 7 lib/domain untyped-id + 72 feature-domain untyped-id + 29 raw Text() literals + 60 widget collection logic). Strict enforcement on production code would either (a) require fixing all 169 in this PR (massive scope blow, outside Phase 21 goal) or (b) flag every existing file forever as warning. Plan §Phase 21 Rizika explicit: 'Custom lint packages přidávají dev dependency a build time. Mitigation: kde lint je heavy, použít grep-based test runnable in CI (cheap).' Two design questions: (1) where do the rules live? (2) how do we enforce on production without forcing mass cleanup?
decisions.decision: (1) **Pure-Dart grep matchers in test/lint/**, no custom_lint plugin, no analyzer plugin, no codegen. Each rule is a top-level function in test/lint/lint_matchers.dart (`isDomainPurityViolation(String line)`, `isUntypedIdDeclaration(String line)`, `isRawTextLiteralViolation(String line)`, `isWidgetCollectionLogicViolation(String line)`) plus a directory walker that returns sorted `relativePath:line :: snippet` violations. Per-line opt-out via `// lint-ignore: <rule-slug>` trailer marker (slugs: domain-purity / untyped-id / l10n-literal / widget-no-logic). Generated files (*.g.dart / *.freezed.dart / *.config.dart) excluded. (2) **Numeric ratchet baselines** in test/lint/production_scan_test.dart: each rule asserts `actual.length <= _baselineXxx`; test fails when violation count grows (new addition) or shrinks (cleanup detected → 'lower the baseline by N and commit alongside'). Baselines calibrated 2026-05-19: domainPurityLibDomain=0 (strict, lib/domain/ already clean), domainPurityFeatureDomain=35, untypedIdLibDomain=7, untypedIdFeatureDomain=72, rawTextLiteral=29, widgetCollectionLogic=60. Fixture coverage in test/lint/lint_fixtures_test.dart: 14 inline-string tests prove each per-line predicate detects the bad pattern + respects the `lint-ignore:` opt-out. Sealed exhaustive switch: Dart 3 compiler auto-enforces on sealed types (compile error, not lint), `exhaustive_cases: true` added to analysis_options.yaml for enum switch coverage. Review checklist + anti-pattern catalogue in docs/contributing.md — covers lint matchers, ratchet protocol, baseline-lowering workflow, plus review-only rules (denormalised caches carry rebuild path, persistence schema frozen, no cross-feature provider reach, no V1 progression imports in new code, l10n closures in catalog). Phase 21 lint baseline cleanup queue tracked v follow_ups.md §2.25 — opportunistic cleanup, per-rule sweep PRs, or rule retirement via `lint-ignore:` marker per violation that turns out intentional.
consequences: DoD §Phase 21 splněna: 4 grep matchers active na production code přes ratchet, exhaustive_cases enabled v analysis_options.yaml, review checklist v docs/contributing.md.
Zero new dev dependencies. No build-time impact (grep matchers run in milliseconds during flutter test). Tests integrate s existing CI test run.

Per-line `// lint-ignore: <rule-slug>` marker s mandatory reason gives explicit + reviewable opt-out path. Reason on the same line means PR reviewer sees both the suppression and the justification in a single diff hunk.

Ratchet semantics make cleanup compounding: any PR that touches a file s violation has natural opportunity to fix + lower baseline. Test failure message ('shrank to N, lower baseline to N') guides the next step.

Pre-existing 169 violations remain v code — Phase 21 explicitly does NOT mass-fix. Cleanup tracked v follow_ups.md §2.25 s scoped recommendations per rule (l10n-literal lowest risk; untyped-id highest because touches aggregate constructors).

Lint matchers live v test/lint/ (not tools/lints/) protože they ARE tests — they run via flutter test, share its discovery + reporting. Future CI extension (e.g. delta-only scan on changed files) can reuse the same per-line predicates.
decisions.alternatives: A) Use custom_lint package (pub.dev/packages/custom_lint) — proper plugin emitting analyzer diagnostics. Odmítnuto: per Phase 21 Rizika, adds dev dependency + build-time cost (analyzer plugin re-runs on every file change). For grep-detectable patterns the plugin is overkill. Reserve for rules that need AST inspection (e.g. detecting a specific widget tree shape). B) Strict enforcement (no baseline) — fail on every existing violation. Odmítnuto: would force fixing 169 violations in this PR, blowing Phase 21 scope; alternatively would force adding 169 `// ignore_for_file:` directives. Neither matches the 'low risk' Phase 21 framing. C) Soft enforcement (test always passes, just logs warning). Odmítnuto: dead checks. No CI gate = no behavior change over time. D) Per-file baseline (allowlist of file:line entries). Odmítnuto: 169-entry text file = noise in diffs + churn on every line shift. Numeric count baseline is 1 int per rule, deltas obvious. Downside accepted: doesn't catch when someone fixes one and adds a different one — but that's a marginal edge case + still caught manually in review. E) Analyzer plugin via dart_code_metrics or similar all-in-one package. Odmítnuto: heavyweight, opinionated, hard to customise. Single Dart file s 4 functions = transparent, debuggable, deletable. F) Skip production scan entirely, fixture-test only. Odmítnuto: matcher s no production check is dead. The ratchet IS the enforcement. G) Different opt-out marker syntax (e.g. `// ignore: lint-name` matching Dart's analyzer suppression). Odmítnuto: Dart's `// ignore:` suppresses analyzer diagnostics; our matcher is grep-based + would conflict semantically. `// lint-ignore: <slug>` is unambiguous, doesn't collide with anything. H) Mandate slug + reason format (`// lint-ignore: <slug> — <reason>`). Considered, demoted to convention in docs/contributing.md (matcher doesn't enforce the dash); enforcement would add regex complexity. Reviewer-enforced. I) Ratchet on count-of-files rather than count-of-lines. Odmítnuto: a file with 10 violations and one s 1 are equally bad for the file ratchet, hiding the real cost. Line count = actual debt. J) Add `exhaustive_cases` for enums but skip docs/contributing.md (rely on analyze output). Odmítnuto: contributing.md doc covers review-only rules (rebuild path for caches, persistence-schema-no-change) which no lint catches. Doc is the single source for non-machine rules.

decisions.title: Phase 22 legacy V1 progression delete — drop background-sync notifications, relocate HeroScreen, swap to V2 Firestore wipe
decisions.context: Domain refactor §Phase 22 (`docs/domain_model/archive/migration_plan.md`) called for: delete `lib/features/progression/` (legacy V1 engine), migrate `background_sync_service.dart` to V2 ProgressionEngineProvider, migrate 3 devtools sections to V2, delete legacy tests. Pre-conditions: Phases 0-21 done (Stage A-E shipped). The companion V2 phased plan (`docs/progression_engine/v2_phased_plan.md`) §Phase 9 carried a similar mandate with status note 2026-05-17: 'working drafts of this phase have already landed on main (the V2 module is in active use on every UI surface) but the final cleanup — deleting lib/features/progression/ wholesale and verifying acceptance — has not been done in a single committed pass.' Reality assessment uncovered two surprises: (1) the 3 devtools sections (devtools_progression_section.dart / devtools_provider_section.dart / devtools_unlock_inventory_section.dart) were already orphaned — Phase 6 of V2 plan dropped them from the devtools UI but left the V1-coupled files behind, zero imports anywhere. (2) `background_sync_service.dart` ran the V1 ProgressionEngine in the WorkManager isolate, writing to a separate V1 Isar DB that diverged from the foreground V2 ledger since V2 plan Phase 6 made V2 canonical — quest/achievement notifications had been firing off stale state (or not firing for V2-completed quests) for the entire coexistence window. Plus a third constraint: `HeroScreen` (the main shell's third tab) + `progression_overview_section.dart` lived under the V1 folder but were already V2-backed internally — only their folder location was V1.
decisions.decision: Mechanical cleanup pass + one explicit feature deferral. **(1) Delete `lib/features/progression/` (46 files) + `test/features/progression/` (8 files)** wholesale. **(2) Delete orphaned devtools sections** (3 files) — no replacement needed; they were dead code post-Phase-6. **(3) Detach V1 progression from `background_sync_service.dart`** — remove the V1 engine.sync(source) call + quest/achievement notification blocks; keep HC + KT data refresh + daily goal reminder + Phase 18 AppError classification. Reason for not migrating to V2 in this PR: proper V2 wiring in the WorkManager headless isolate requires `EngineEvaluationContext` construction (Player.fromJournal + LedgerCounters derivation + InMemoryJournal wrap of engine.ledger.all) — ~150-200 LoC of careful headless-isolate plumbing that the user wouldn't notice for a delight-only feature whose pre-Phase-22 implementation was already broken (writing to wrong ledger). Deferred as scoped follow-up in [follow_ups.md §2.26](../../domain_model/follow_ups.md#226-v2-background-quest--achievement-notifications-deferred-from-phase-22). **(4) Relocate `hero_screen.dart` + `progression_overview_section.dart`** from `lib/features/progression/presentation/{hero,widgets}/` → `lib/features/progression_engine/presentation/{,widgets/}` via `git show HEAD:... > new-path` after the initial folder delete. Strip V1 imports (drop `ProgressionDomainTheme.colorFor(d)` / `iconFor(d)` for V2's `d.color` / `d.icon` — V2 ProgressionDomain has the design-token getters native to the enum). Update `lib/features/app_shell/presentation/main_shell.dart` + `lib/features/social/presentation/widgets/hero_progression_header.dart` to point at the new locations. **(5) Swap devtools factory-reset purge** from V1 `FirestoreProgressionGateway.wipeAllRemoteData` (wiped `users/{uid}/progressionClaims/*` + `achievementUnlocks/*` + `progression/state` doc) to V2 `FirestoreProgressionEngineGateway.wipeAll` (wipes `engineObjectiveCompletions` + `engineNodeCompletions` + `engineNodeClaims` + `engineNodeAnnouncements` + `engineRewardGrants` + `engineQuestOfferings`). Legacy V1 Firestore docs orphan harmlessly per V2 plan §11.1 ('Social Firestore data referencing old node ids is acceptable to break'). **(6) Fix one stale test import** in `test/features/progression_engine/quest_section_panel_test.dart` (drop V1 `progression/domain/models/core_models.dart`, swap to V2 `progression_engine/domain/progression_domain.dart`). **(7) Lower Phase 21 lint ratchet baselines** as a natural side-effect: domain-purity feature-domain 35→33, untyped-id feature-domain 72→58, raw-Text-literal 29→19, widget-collection-logic 60→46.
consequences: Domain refactor §Phase 22 DoD met: `lib/features/progression/` deleted, no regressions, Hero tab still renders, factory reset still wipes Firestore engine data, `flutter analyze` clean (same 77 pre-existing `unnecessary_const` infos in catalog content), core test suite passes (`test/features/progression_engine/`, `test/features/social/`, `test/features/cosmetics/`, `test/lint/`, `test/domain_purity_test.dart`).

V2 phased plan §Phase 9 also closed in the same commit: V1 module deleted, legacy `as legacy` import prefixes gone (none existed in the final pass), V1 Isar collections orphan (factory reset path no longer references them). Acceptance bullets §Phase 9 met: `grep -r "features/progression/" lib/` returns zero hits.

Background sync notification feature regressed (consciously): WorkManager no longer pushes notifications for newly-granted quest rewards / newly-unlocked achievements. Net effect on users: same as today — pre-Phase-22 notifications were already broken because the V1 engine writes to a divergent ledger from V2. Restoring the feature on V2 substrate is deferred to a scoped follow-up (follow_ups.md §2.26).
Phase 21 ratchet baselines lowered by ~30% for typed-id + l10n debt + ~23% for widget-logic debt. V1 deletion alone removed substantial pre-existing violations.

Stage E of the domain refactor (Phases 20-22) now closed. Refactor complete. Open work tracks in follow_ups.md §2 (opportunistic cleanup + Phase 21 baseline reduction + V2 background notifications + other deferrals).

V2 phased plan (`v2_phased_plan.md`) + Phase 8/9 handoff (`phase_8_9_handoff.md`) archived under `docs/progression_engine/archive/`. Phase 8 (RPG mode readiness) extracted as standalone phase-free spec `docs/progression_engine/rpg_mode_readiness.md` — open work item, no implementation yet, picked up when product asks for the toggle UI.
decisions.alternatives: A) Properly migrate background sync to V2 ProgressionEngineProvider in this PR. Rejected: ~150-200 LoC of headless-isolate plumbing (Player.fromJournal derivation + LedgerCounters bootstrap + InMemoryJournal wrap + diff against pre-sync snapshot by event key) for a delight-only feature whose pre-Phase-22 implementation was already broken. Scope creep beyond 'delete V1' mandate. Deferred to its own scoped story with explicit notification entry point preserved (NotificationService.showQuestCompleted / showAchievementUnlocked remain unused but available). B) Keep V1 folder but mark it deprecated and exclude from `flutter analyze`. Rejected: defeats the purpose of Phase 22 (the cleanup), keeps 46 legacy files + 8 test files in the repo as a permanent maintenance burden, and the V1 engine continues to drift further from V2 with every future change. C) Move HeroScreen + ProgressionOverviewSection to `lib/features/progression_engine/presentation/hero/` (preserve sub-folder structure from V1). Rejected: only one hero screen per app; a hero/ folder for a single file is over-organization. Flat layout under `presentation/` is cleaner. D) Keep V1's `progression_domain_theme.dart` as a shim. Rejected: V2's ProgressionDomain enum carries `.token` / `.color` / `.icon` natively (per Phase 16 engine signature refactor) — calling them directly is shorter, more idiomatic, and removes one indirection. E) Build a one-shot Firestore migration to rewrite V1 ids (`progressionClaims`, `achievementUnlocks`) to V2 ids in users' historical docs. Rejected per V2 plan §11.1: 'Social Firestore data referencing old node ids is acceptable to break — friend achievement grids can render Unknown tiles for historical entries until those ids are re-published under new V2 names.' Adds a migration runner the project explicitly avoids. F) Hold Phase 22 until V2 background notifications are also designed + built. Rejected: V2 plan §Phase 9 + domain refactor §Phase 22 both treat the V1 delete as the priority; the notification feature is genuinely orthogonal and shouldn't gate the cleanup. Deferral is documented + the entry point (NotificationService) preserved. G) Inline the V1 Firestore wipe collection list in the purge service rather than depending on V2's FirestoreProgressionEngineGateway.wipeAll. Rejected: would duplicate the V2 gateway's collection list (engineNodeCompletions + 5 others) in the purge service. The V2 gateway is the single source of truth; the purge service should delegate. H) Rename `progression_engine` → `progression` after V1 delete (per V2 plan §Phase 9 'rename progression_engine/ → progression/'). Rejected: ~120 files would change imports for purely cosmetic reasons. The `progression_engine` name is no longer confusing (V1 is gone), so the rename adds churn without benefit. Naming stays as-is. I) Mark Phase 22 done in `migration_plan.md` but skip the V2 plan archival in the same commit. Rejected: per CLAUDE.md 'Closing out a finished plan' workflow, archival happens in the same commit as the final phase closure. Splitting into two commits means a future session lands in a stale `phase_8_9_handoff.md` brief that no longer accurately describes the open work.

Populate `QuestLocked.remaining`, `AchievementLocked.remaining`, `ChapterLocked.gate` via the existing read-projection services backed by a new `UnlockConditionResolver.unsatisfied(...)` method that flows through `ProgressionResolutionResult.lockedNodeRemainingConditions`. Promote `PlayerQuest.id: QuestId` to `PlayerQuest.quest: Quest` (proposal §2.4), keeping a forwarded `QuestId get id` for backward compat. Ship in two commits (R.1.a move + cross-reference typing, R.1.b lifecycle field enrichment + PlayerQuest.quest) to keep each PR under 800 LoC, per the protocol the 22-phase plan established. Lower Phase 21 lint baselines accordingly (domain-purity features 33→25, untyped-id features 58→36).
consequences: lib/domain/progression/catalog/ is now the canonical home for every progression catalog vocabulary symbol — future cloud-hosted catalog work (Track B.1) can swap-out the Quest catalog without touching feature code beyond catalog content files.

Five new typed-id wrappers (ChainId, ComboPoolId, DailyTierGroupId, TitleId, EmblemId) join the existing seven; cross-feature passing of these ids is compile-time discriminated. Authoring sites at catalog content + helper builders construct via `const ChainId('foo')` rather than raw strings.
Phase 21 `untyped-id` baseline in feature `domain/` dropped 22 entries (58→36); `domain-purity` baseline dropped 8 entries (33→25). The R.6 cleanup queue in follow_ups.md narrows correspondingly.

ProgressionDomain split means widget chrome consumers (~6 files in progression_engine/presentation and 2 in social/presentation) now import progression_domain_chrome.dart in addition to the pure enum. Catalog content files reference only the pure enum (no chrome).

ChainStepIcon enum + chapter-card mapping eliminates the IconData domain leak; the catalog row never sees a Flutter type. Three named glyphs cover all current usage; adding a new glyph means one enum case + one switch arm.

Tests rebuilt to construct a minimal `DailyQuest` fixture; the legacy forwarded `id` getter keeps Phase 7 PlayerQuestCatalog.byId(QuestId) lookups intact.
decisions.alternatives: A) Stay-in-feature with typed cross-references only — keep the catalog row classes in `lib/features/progression_engine/domain/models/` and tighten cross-reference fields in place. Rejected per proposal §6 vocabulary discipline: catalog vocabulary belongs in lib/domain/ so future cloud-hosted catalog swap-outs (Track B.1) have a clean seam; staying in features keeps the architectural drift the 22-phase plan was meant to close. B) Keep cosmetic-feature CosmeticId separate from the new lib/domain CosmeticId (i.e. two distinct namespaces). Rejected: catalog rows in lib/domain (CompanionAvailability, Relic, ContentUnlock, CosmeticReward) need to reference cosmetic ids and lib/domain cannot import features; either CosmeticId moves to lib/domain or the catalog needs a duplicate typed wrapper. Choosing consolidation removes the duplicate and matches the proposal's hybrid layout (typed identifiers are cross-aggregate vocabulary). C) Keep IconData on Quest.chainStepIcon and add a `package:flutter/widgets.dart` whitelist exception to the domain-purity lint. Rejected: weakens the domain purity guarantee for a single field; the three named glyphs map cleanly to an enum without losing expressive power. D) Add structural `==` / `hashCode` to ProgressionEntry / Quest as part of R.1 so PlayerQuest can use `quest == quest` equality. Rejected: introduces ~20 sealed-subtype equality overrides as drive-by work outside the R.1 scope. The PlayerQuest equality keys on `quest.id` instead — the projection's natural identity matches Phase 7's cache-invalidation semantic and the tests already assumed id-based equality. E) Make `ChapterLocked.gate` non-nullable per proposal §4.4. Rejected: chapters can be locked by ActivationPolicy alone (RPG mode off, no explicit condition) or by an implicit gate the service doesn't surface; a nullable gate lets the screen fall back to a generic Locked card in those cases instead of forcing a synthetic placeholder condition. F) Defer the ProgressionDomain chrome split — keep the original Flutter-coupled enum in features. Rejected: Objective.domain references ProgressionDomain and Objective moves to lib/domain in R.1; the enum must go with it. Splitting chrome out is the only clean path that keeps both ends pure.

decisions.title: R.2 — NodeState enum → boolean-derived NodeResolution
decisions.context: Phase 13 inlined a resolver-internal `enum NodeState { locked, available, completed }` into `lib/features/progression_engine/domain/evaluator/progression_node_resolver.dart`, parking it as evaluator vocabulary after every player-facing surface had migrated to the per-aggregate sealed lifecycles (PlayerQuestLifecycle / PlayerAchievementLifecycle / ChapterLifecycle). The engine consumer (`progression_engine.dart`) then pattern-matched with `switch (r.state)` + `case _ when r.state.name == 'completed'` / `'available'` — string-comparing enum names rather than typed matching. The setup was a remnant of the V2 origin design and a textbook proposal §7 anti-pattern #6 ("lifecycle as flags"): NodeResolution already carried `eligibleByConditions`, `objectiveCompleted`, plus implicit knowledge of `alreadyCompleted` / `alreadyClaimed`; the enum tag just re-encoded combinations of those booleans. Track A R.2 was scoped to remove it.
decisions.decision: Drop `enum NodeState` entirely. Replace the `state: NodeState` field on `NodeResolution` with a single `completed: bool` that captures the resolver's classification ("this node is a completion-event candidate this run"). Engine consumer derives the three classifications directly from the booleans: locked = `!eligibleByConditions`, completed = `r.completed`, available = otherwise. The awkward `switch (r.state) { case _ when r.state.name == … }` block collapses to a flat `if (r.completed && !ledger.hasEventKey) … else if (!r.completed && r.eligibleByConditions && r.objectiveCompleted == true && r.node.claimPolicy == ClaimPolicy.manual) …`. Resolver factory call sites pass `completed: true` for the two completed branches (already-in-ledger and auto-claim-just-satisfied) and `completed: false` everywhere else (locked, in-progress, manual-claim-waiting). Stale doc comments in player_chapter_progress_service, player_achievement_shelf_service, engine_achievement_view, player_achievement_lifecycle, and one test header that referenced `NodeState.locked` are rephrased to "resolver classified the node as locked" (the semantics they were describing).
consequences: One fewer type in the resolver surface; no string-compared enum names crossing module boundaries.

Engine consumer's conditional is now readable as plain English (`r.completed && !already-in-ledger` vs the previous switch-with-`case _ when` pattern). The `claimPolicy.name == 'manual'` string compare is replaced with the typed `== ClaimPolicy.manual`.

NodeResolution fields (eligibleByConditions, objectiveCompleted, completed, periodKey) form the complete public surface; the resolver state machine is now fully observable via its outputs without an internal enum tag.

Proposal §7 anti-pattern #6 ("lifecycle as flags") would have applied to a sealed NodeResolution hierarchy mirroring the boolean combinations — by collapsing the enum into one extra boolean the resolver stays single-class while the player-facing sealed lifecycles remain the only sealed hierarchies in the progression domain.
No lint-baseline change — the enum removal didn't add or remove any untyped-id / domain-purity / widget-no-logic violations; baselines remain 25 / 36 / 19 / 46. R.6 cleanup queue unaffected.
decisions.alternatives: A) Introduce a sealed `NodeResolution` hierarchy with three subtypes (NodeResolutionLocked / Available / Completed) and exhaustive switch in the engine. Rejected: only one real consumer in the codebase (progression_engine.dart — reward_grant_planner doesn't read state, progression_display_resolver doesn't use NodeResolution at all).
